name: story
description: Choose the next Story Factory command for a story project or explain the command suite.

name: story-new
description: Create a fresh film-writing project with templates and skills for Claude Code and Codex.

name: story-office-hours
description: Explore a story seed through a focused conversation before outlining or drafting.

name: story-research
description: Research a based-on or inspired-by true story using source-led native subagent work.

name: story-premise
description: Challenge a film premise, choose its scope, and establish the dramatic promise.

name: story-outline
description: Design characters, causal scenes, chronology, and the structure of a film story.

name: story-draft
description: Write complete screenplay scenes from an established story plan.

name: story-review
description: Diagnose a full screenplay with concrete scene evidence before revising it.

name: story-studio
description: Review an existing screenplay as a studio development editor and ask the writer to choose concrete improvements.

name: story-revise
description: Implement prioritized screenplay repairs and recheck the revised draft.

name: story-bechdel
description: Assess screenplay conversations against a named-women Bechdel test with scene evidence.

name: story-quality
description: Review screenplay craft, representation, and production feasibility with scene evidence.

name: story-truth
description: Audit factual claims, dramatizations, and source-based labels against a research ledger.

name: story-package
description: Create a coherent studio development package and reader-specific pitches from a draft.

name: story-check
description: Compile screenplay deliverables and check actual PDFs, continuity, and completeness.

name: story-handoff
description: Prepare an honest inventory of a story project and its editable deliverables.

name: story-resume
description: Recover story decisions, progress, and the next action from a saved project.

name: story-run
description: Carry a story project through the staged writing and review process within user scope.
